recipe.name: Viscum / investment / Gold 18k
recipe.calibration_note: Starting values; verify with shop trials

manufacturing.bench_notes: Factory 017 Tonneau at native 16 x 12 through its sand master, lost wax, sprued at the palm. The sprig, its leaves, twigs and joints are cast with the ring. After the pour: true each berry's bearing in its collet, set the moonstone and burnish the lip. Polish the leaves and twigs; pumice the table round the sprig.
